zoning.label: Official mapped zoning
zoning.note: Mapped from the Stevens County zoning map (Title 3 districts). Verify allowed uses, density, setbacks and overlays with Stevens County Land Services. This district is in the Lake Spokane urban growth area (UGA).

urbanGrowthArea.name: Lake Spokane
urbanGrowthArea.note: Inside the Lake Spokane urban growth area (UGA) designated by the Stevens County Comprehensive Plan. The county's UGA layer says: "This dataset shows the Urban Growth Areas (UGA) designated by the Stevens County Comprehensive Plan. The dataset also shows the zoning areas designated by the Stevens County Development Regulations Title 3." Outside city limits, the Stevens County Title 3 district mapped here applies; confirm with Stevens County Land Services, and with the city where the UGA belongs to one, before relying on it.
